figurative_meaning_en: facing a difficult or testing situation
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কর্মজীবনে সীতার অগ্নিপরীক্ষার মতো কঠিন পরীক্ষা এসেছে।
এই সংকট তার জন্য সীতার অগ্নিপরীক্ষা প্রমাণ করবে।
example_sentences_in_english: His career faced a trial by fire like Sita's ordeal.
This crisis will be her baptism of fire.
history: Derived from the Ramayana epic, where Sita undergoes an agni pariksha (fire ordeal) to prove her chastity after her abduction by Ravana, symbolizing ultimate proof of innocence under duress.
note: Strongly tied to Hindu mythology, often used to denote severe personal trials.
